name: The Impatient Newcomer
objective: Find the primary call-to-action button and click it. PASS requires that a visible change occurs as a result, such as a new panel, a message, or a navigation, AND that something visibly present now contains real content. Report PASS if both hold. Otherwise report FAIL and state what did not change.

name: The Skeptical Reader
objective: PASS requires that every link and button has a clear text label, that no element says 'undefined', 'null', 'NaN', 'Lorem ipsum', 'TODO' or 'coming soon', and that there are no broken image placeholders. Report PASS if all conditions hold. Otherwise report FAIL and quote the exact offending text.

name: The Mobile User
objective: Use the page at a narrow mobile viewport of 375px wide. PASS requires that the primary content is readable AND that the primary call-to-action is visible and tappable without horizontal scrolling. Report PASS if both hold. Otherwise report FAIL and state what was cut off, overlapping, or scrolling sideways.

name: The Form Filler
objective: Fill in every input field with a plausible value and submit the form. PASS requires that a clear success or error confirmation appears AND that no field was silently dropped. Report PASS if both hold. Otherwise report FAIL and describe what happened on submit.

name: The Promise Checker
objective: Read the headline and the primary button text, then click the button. PASS requires that what the headline promises is actually delivered AND that the button label matches what the page advertises. Report PASS if both hold. Otherwise report FAIL and quote both the headline and the button text.
